name: flashing-lights
description: Emergency RGBA light: tscircuit hardware sources and fab tooling

scripts.led:fab: node tools/pcbflow/fab.mjs dist/hardware/led-board/circuit.json hardware/led-board.bom.mjs fab/led-board && python3 tools/pcbflow/gerbercheck.py fab/led-board/gerber build/led-gerber-top.svg
scripts.led: npm run led:build && npm run led:drc && npm run led:fab
scripts.ctl:fab: node tools/pcbflow/fab.mjs build/control-board/control-board.routed.json hardware/control-board.bom.mjs fab/control-board && python3 tools/pcbflow/gerbercheck.py fab/control-board/gerber build/ctl-gerber-top.svg
scripts.ctl: npm run ctl:build && npm run ctl:route && npm run ctl:fab
